verdict.rationale: Cline's Kanban board runs many coding agents in parallel with isolated worktrees, subagents spawn multiple parallel research tasks, and cron scheduling plus headless CLI mode enable automation across many tasks/items at scale. This directly supports bulk, multi-item automation for an AI-native workflow, though it's framed around parallel agent tasks rather than explicit 'batch over items' tooling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of large-scale parallel runs and any explicit bulk-edit/batch-processing use case beyond agent parallelism.
